lines.en: I walk the wall line with my rifle up.
Feet planted, muzzle steady.
I check each step and round the corner.
Magazine full. No panic.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，往掩体后挪。
lines.en: I crouch and shift behind cover.

lines.zh: 靴子踩在碎玻璃上，很响。
lines.en: My boots crunch the broken glass.

lines.zh: 我走的是射界里最安全的位置。
lines.en: I take the safest line of fire.
I walk half a step behind my partner.
I sweep the window as I pass.

lines.zh: 这一片，我按巡逻路线走。
lines.en: I walk this patch on patrol route.
My shadow runs long on the wall.
I shift the rifle to the other hand.
I stand with the muzzle lowered.
I cinch my sling one notch tighter.
The wind takes the smoke away.
There is still a ringing in my ears.
I wait for orders.
I press the numb web of my thumb.
I settle my armor.
It is quiet here. For now.
I glance at the high ground.
Who is on that roof?
Hands up. Do not move.
The muzzle is at your chest.
Name and purpose.
Which faction are you with?

lines.zh: 我看见你腰上的东西了。
lines.en: I see what is on your belt.
Six paces. Stop there.
I do not like the look in your eye.
Stop, hands out of your pockets.
Your hand hasn't left your gun.
Are we on the same side?
A round grazed my ribs.
The armor took half of it.
I fire back from one knee.
My shoulder has gone numb.
I press my sleeve against the wound.
Blood drips from my sleeve.
Two breaths and I have it under control.
I press the wound and keep watching.
I can still fight.
I'm not down yet - keep firing.
Set it down. Do not bring it closer.
What would that buy?
I am not short on food.
Are you trying to buy me?
Set it down and take three steps back.
What I need is ammunition.
Thanks, but I have rations.

lines.zh: 我不拿不明来路的东西。
lines.en: I do not take things of unknown origin.
That would barely buy a magazine.
I will remember the favor.
Bump me and the gun may go off.
Get back. There is a wall behind me.
Hands off my barrel.
Do not crowd me. I am setting up.
I shoulder you aside.
Armor on armor, loud.
Your shoulder knocked my rifle off line.
Too narrow here to pivot.
You kicked my magazine loose.
Call out before you come near.
Not during an operation.
She is in the unit too.

lines.zh: 我们互相看一眼，就够了。
lines.en: One look between us is enough.
I hand her my last magazine.
This is a back-to-back kind of bond.
Before dawn, we go to our posts.
She holds the left. I hold the right.
We waste no words.

lines.zh: 一起活下来的，才是同伴。
lines.en: Only those who survive together are companions.
Whoever sleeps tonight wins.
Ammunition. I will take it.
Whose rifle is this?
The caliber doesn't match.
I slot it into my chest pouch.
This gun's missing a part.
I pick it up and read the serial.
I strip out its magazine.
Put it back. Leave it alone.
I signal to the man beside me.
We take what is serviceable.
Target in view.
Rifle up.
Target's behind the railing.
Fifteen paces out.
Everyone, ready.
Hold still. I am on you.
Give me the password.
Wrong password.
I fire at three.
Crossfire. Leave no gap.
It is moving. Track it.
I have this angle covered.
You have stepped into the kill zone.
My sights are glued to you.

lines.zh: 退后，这是最后一次警告。
lines.en: Back off. Final warning.
I'm waiting for half your head to show.
That pillar won't stop armor-piercing rounds.
Shift position and go around.

lines.zh: 两个人的角度，够封住他。
lines.en: Two angles will pin him.
I keep the sight on your chest.
Slow the breath. Do not shake.
Twenty rounds left.
You pulled back - I can wait.
You keep stopping and starting; I notice.
One more step and you show.
No hurry. Bullets are fast.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住这个口径。
lines.en: That armor will not stop this caliber.
I hold fire and wait for you.
There is another gun behind you.
Hear that? The bolt.
A magazine change. Quick.
I am moving to higher ground.

lines.zh: 这栋楼，每个窗口都有人。
lines.en: Every window in this block has someone.
We've got the alley mouth sealed.
The door is sealed.
I have fired.
Three-round burst. Pinning him.
Aimed shots, not spray.
I shift to the other side of cover.
Casings hit the floor, bright and sharp.
Hit. He staggered.
I put in another.
Move and fire again.
Launcher. Clear it out.
Push with the flamethrower.

lines.zh: 我把枪托砸进他的胸口。
lines.en: I drive the stock into his chest.
The barrel has gone hot.
I hold the trigger down.
Half a step back to reload.
He did not get up again.
Again. Aimed fire.
This round was saved for you.
Room clear.
I land and check my surroundings first.
Gun present. Ammo present.
This is not my sector.
I crouch and lower the muzzle.
I'm here to take over this post.
Where is the high ground here?
First, cover.
There is cordite on the wind.
Who deployed me here?
I check the magazine once more.
This block is too quiet.
I take the wall and wait for orders.

lines.zh: 火烧到护甲上，烫得我直缩。
lines.en: Fire on my armor, and I flinch.

lines.zh: 从二楼摔下来，腿先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the second floor, legs first.
Water in my mouth and nose. I lose the rifle.

lines.zh: 爆风把我和枪一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my rifle.
A round punched through my pauldron.

lines.zh: 这玩意让我的手指僵了。
lines.en: This thing has stiffened my fingers.
Two days hungry and my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我眼前全是白光。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and everything goes white.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我一直在坠。
lines.en: No floor under me. I keep falling.
